label: NHANES August 2021-August 2023 adult anthropometry supplement
source: Fryar CD, Gu Q, Afful J, Carroll MD, Ogden CL. Anthropometric Reference Data for Children and Adults: United States, August 2021-August 2023. Vital Health Stat 3. 2025 Jun;(50):1-28. DOI: 10.15620/cdc/174595.
includedPopulation: Civilian noninstitutionalized U.S. adults age 20 and older examined in NHANES August 2021-August 2023.
excludedPopulation: Pregnant females are excluded from the published weight, waist, and hip adult tables. Children and adolescents are not used in this overlay.
sdMethod: Standard deviation is estimated from the published 5th and 95th percentiles as (p95 - p5) / 3.2897 so the existing normal percentile helper can consume the source. Published NHANES percentiles remain stored with each field.
notes: This overlay replaces only fields that directly match the app measurement schema and the published adult NHANES tables.
Unsupported schema fields continue to use the labeled dummy scaffold until ANSUR or another vetted source is implemented.
The source tables report weighted means and selected percentiles; sample counts are unweighted.
